6818.title: Desktop startup during incomplete payload installation
6818.rootCauseOneLine: The launcher consumes an incomplete payload immediately and treats an early module-load exit as terminal; native Windows installer timing remains unverified.
6818.proposedFix: Verify a bounded installer/launcher completion handshake on native Windows before implementing update-coordination changes.
6818.caveats: Both direct clean-checkout runs used Linux/Node with Windows runtime selection and a synthetic missing payload; no Windows installer, Electron UI, pino incident, daemon lock, or data integrity claim was reproduced.
